get.summary: Gets a single article by guid
get.description: Retrieves a single article by its unique identifier.

patch.summary: Updates part of an existing article
patch.description: Updates only article fields included in the request body.

delete.description: Deletes the specified article from the system.

get.summary: Gets a single article by barcode
get.description: Retrieves a single article by barcode and barcode type using the {barcode}:{type} route value.
Retrieves a paginated list of articles.

post.description: Creates a new article with optional partitions, barcodes, and active state. Returns the generated identifier.

get.description: Retrieves a single item by its unique identifier.

patch.description: Replaces mutable item state including partitions and parent container.

delete.description: Deletes the specified item from the system.

get.description: Retrieves a list of items that represents the location of the contained item.
Retrieves a list of moviments that represents the moviment history of item.
Retrieves a paginated list of items.

post.description: Creates a new item with optional partitions. Returns the generated identifier.

get.description: Retrieves a single user by its unique identifier.

put.description: Replaces all user state including partitions, user groups, and permissions.

delete.description: Deletes the specified user from the system.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users.

post.description: Creates a new user with optional partitions, user groups, and permissions. Returns the generated identifier.

get.description: Retrieves a single user group by its unique identifier.

put.description: Replaces all user group state including partitions and permissions.

delete.description: Deletes the specified user group from the system.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of user groups.

post.description: Creates a new user group with optional partitions and permissions. Returns the generated identifier.

get.description: Retrieves a single partition by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Deletes the specified partition from the system.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of partitions.

post.description: Creates a new partition under an parent. Returns the generated identifier.

Invalidates the current refresh token or session.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audit logs.

ActionType.description: Represents the set of actions in the system.

ActorType.description:
Represents the type of actor responsible for performing an action
within the system.

ean13.description: The optional EAN-13 barcode of the article.

ean13.description:
The new EAN-13 barcode to assign to the article. A `null` value
leaves the existing EAN-13 barcode unchanged.

removeEan13.description:
Indicates whether the existing EAN-13 barcode should be removed by setting its
value to `null`.

ArticleBarcodeUpdateDto.description: Represents the barcode changes to apply to an article.

maxMass.description: The optional maximum mass that the container can hold.

ArticleContainerDto.description: Represents the container information associated with an article.

description.description: The optional description of the article.

articleType.description: The type of article to create.

oneOf.description:
The optional variation configuration. Required when ArticleType
is ArticleType.Variation.

The optional pack configuration. Required when ArticleType
is ArticleType.Pack.

kitComponents.description:
The optional components of the article. Required when ArticleType
is ArticleType.Kit.

oneOf.description: The optional container configuration when creating a container article.

shelfLife.description: The optional shelf life of the article.

color.description: The optional color of the article.

mass.description: The optional mass of the article.

oneOf.description: The optional physical dimensions of the article.
The optional barcode information of the article.

partitionsToAdd.description: The optional identifiers of partitions to associate with the article.

ArticleCreateDto.description: Represents the data required to create an article.

lengthX.description: The optional length along the X axis.

lengthY.description: The optional length along the Y axis.

lengthZ.description: The optional length along the Z axis.

ArticleDimensionDto.description: Represents the physical dimensions of an article.

lengthX.description:
The new length along the X axis. A `null` value leaves the
existing value unchanged.

removeLengthX.description:
Indicates whether the existing X-axis length should be removed by setting it
to `null`. When `true`, this takes precedence
over LengthX.

lengthY.description:
The new length along the Y axis. A `null` value leaves the
existing value unchanged.

removeLengthY.description:
Indicates whether the existing Y-axis length should be removed by setting it
to `null`. When `true`, this takes precedence
over LengthY.

lengthZ.description:
The new length along the Z axis. A `null` value leaves the
existing value unchanged.

removeLengthZ.description:
Indicates whether the existing Z-axis length should be removed by setting it
to `null`. When `true`, this takes precedence
over LengthZ.

ArticleDimensionUpdateDto.description: Represents the dimensional changes to apply to an article.

guid.description: The unique identifier of the article.

shelfLife.description: The optional shelf life of the article.

oneOf.description: The optional color of the article.
The optional mass of the article.

dimension.description: The physical dimensions of the article.

oneOf.description: The variation information when the article is a variation; otherwise, `null`.
The packaging information when the article is a pack; otherwise, `null`.

kitComponents.description: The components that compose the article when it is a kit; otherwise, `null`.

oneOf.description: The container information when the article is a container; otherwise, `null`.

barcodes.description: The barcodes associated with the article.

partitions.description: The identifiers of the partitions associated with the article.

ArticleDto.description: Represents the application-layer data transfer object for an article.

articleGuid.description: The unique identifier of the article used as a component.

quantity.description: The quantity of the article included in the kit.

ArticleKitComponentDto.description: Represents a component of a kit article.

fromArticleGuid.description: The unique identifier of the article from which the pack is composed.

quantity.description: The quantity of the source article contained in the pack.

ArticlePackDto.description: Represents the packaging information for an article pack.

ArticleType.description: Represents the classification of an article within the inventory system.

name.description: The new name of the article. A `null` value leaves the existing name unchanged.

description.description: The new description of the article. A `null` value leaves the existing description unchanged.

shelfLife.description: The new shelf life of the article. A `null` value leaves the existing value unchanged.

removeShelfLife.description:
Indicates whether the existing shelf life should be removed by setting it to `null`.
When `true`, this takes precedence over ShelfLife.

mass.description: The new mass of the article. A `null` value leaves the existing value unchanged.

removeMass.description:
Indicates whether the existing mass should be removed by setting it to `null`.
When `true`, this takes precedence over Mass.

oneOf.description: The optional dimensional changes to apply to the article.
The optional barcode changes to apply to the article.

partitionsToAdd.description: The identifiers of partitions to associate with the article.

partitionsToRemove.description: The identifiers of partitions to disassociate from the article.

ArticleUpdateDto.description: Represents the changes to apply to an existing article.

fromArticleGuid.description: The unique identifier of the article from which the variation was created.

ArticleVariationDto.description: Represents the variation information of an article.

accessToken.description: The generated access token used to authenticate API requests.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token used to obtain a new access token when the current one expires.

expiresAt.description: The date and time when the access token expires.

AuthResult.description: Represents the result of a successful authentication.

Token.description: Represents a security token used by the system.

password.description: The initial password for the user's authentication credentials.

defaultPasswordExpirationPeriod.description: The period after which the user's password expires.

UserAuthenticationCreateDto.description: Represents the data required to create authentication information for a user.

defaultPasswordExpirationPeriod.description: The default period after which the user's password expires.

requirePasswordChangeAt.description: The date and time at which the user is required to change their password.
